name: amfx-audusd-divergence
description: amFX reproduction (30MAR23 p4): AUDUSD vs risk-on proxies (S&P 500, VIX inverse). Shows AUD underperforming its traditional drivers from Feb 2023 onward. Risk assets rallied while AUD weakened, signaling a structural drag (Australian rates policy). Uses common_economic_indicators for S&P 500 and VIX. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: AUDUSD vs RISK-ON DRIVERS (30MAR23 p4)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's divergence chart: AUD weakness vs its drivers.
# Original shows AUDUSD vs Copper, Gold, Hang Seng on TradingView.
# Reproduction uses S&P 500 and VIX as risk-on/risk-off proxies
# (available via common_economic_indicators).
# Key insight: AUD decoupled from all drivers in Feb-Mar 2023.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
audusd = src.c

# =============================================================================
# RISK PROXIES FROM COMMON ECONOMIC INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# S&P 500 (risk-on proxy, replaces Hang Seng)
sp500_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.SP500)()
sp500 = ffill(sp500_src.result)

# VIX (risk-off proxy, inverted = risk-on)
vix_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.VIX)()
vix = ffill(vix_src.result)

# Inverted VIX as risk-on signal (low VIX = risk-on, same direction as AUD)
vix_inv = 0 - vix

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# NORMALIZE: Cumulative return from period start
# =============================================================================

audusd_first = audusd >> 120
sp500_first = sp500 >> 120
vix_inv_first = vix_inv >> 120

# Percent change from ~120 bars ago (approx 6 months)
audusd_norm = (audusd / audusd_first - 1) * 100
sp500_norm = (sp500 / sp500_first - 1) * 100
vix_inv_norm = (vix_inv / vix_inv_first - 1) * 100

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Normalized Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Is AUD Decoupling from Risk Sentiment?',
    category='AUD Divergence',
    y_axis_label='Change from 6M Ago (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='AUDUSD', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='S&P 500', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Inverted VIX (Risk-On)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Flat', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, audusd_norm, sp500_norm, vix_inv_norm)
